brief: Compare planned and actual spending, locate the change, and revise a controllable future amount without hiding a shortfall.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Revise a plan"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Ajusta un plan"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Ajuste um plano"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Compare planned and actual spending, locate the change, and revise a controllable future amount without hiding a shortfall.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: A plan is a forecast, not a promise. Actual payments show what needs changing next.
instruction.misconception: Treating a budget as a moral score or changing the record to make the plan appear successful.
instruction.numeracy_support: Subtract visible whole amounts; distinguish a completed expense from an optional future payment.

evidence.reasoning: Transport was planned at 40 but cost 50. The extra 10 reduces money available for other spending.
An optional purchase can be reduced or delayed. Record the real transport payment to keep the balance accurate.
The difference measures the extra spending.
A reliable record preserves what actually happened.
The unplaced order is still a controllable future decision.
A real shortfall needs action beyond rearranging labels.
Repeated actual costs give evidence for a better forecast.
The revised optional amount reflects the real extra cost.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Apply this skill in a later integrated decision with a different constraint.

pt-BR.line: Uma compra opcional pode ser reduzida ou adiada. Mantenha o pagamento real de transporte para que o saldo fique correto.
